blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Palace press officer Claire Castro on Tuesday called “absolutely delusional” the call for President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to step down from office. This came after Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson, Paolo Panelo Jr., said Monday that Marcos is “trivializing” Duterte’s “serious accusations” against him, claiming this proved that he is out of touch with reality
